construction_rule.name: AUX_SURFACE_CUE_PCA_OCTANT_VERTEX_V1
construction_rule.basis: Vertex covariance eigenvectors in descending eigenvalue order; axis sign makes largest absolute component positive; third axis flipped if needed for right-handed basis.
construction_rule.regions: Eight PCA-box half-space octants around the PCA box midpoint, bitXYZ0/1 = lower/upper. Empty region retains null.
construction_rule.candidate: Nearest original mesh vertex to each PCA box corner within its octant, squared Euclidean model-mm distance, exact first original vertex index tie.
construction_rule.pruning: None. All eight AUX regions retained, including empty/duplicate candidates.
construction_rule.semantic_claim: Actual scanned mesh surface point only; corner/junction/part identity remains UNKNOWN until separate actual RGB evidence.
construction_rule.historical_V100: Original rejected AABB definition unchanged; these are new AUX IDs, not corrected native8.

visibility_evidence.available: Official GT pose/K + mm mesh; scene depth*depth_scale to mm; intended visible/amodal mask; complete same-frame visible-instance masks per scene_gt.
visibility_evidence.self_visibility_required: Target-alone mesh ray first-hit must match the fixed surface candidate within separately frozen geometric/raster uncertainty; own target mask membership alone cannot distinguish another target surface in front.
visibility_evidence.D_candidate: Only self-visible surface projection, valid consistent observed depth and unique intended visible owner support can become a conditional surface-visible proposal; RGB correspondence still requires review.
visibility_evidence.E_candidate: Only self-visible expected surface, clearly nearer observed depth and unique different annotated instance visible owner support can become conditional external occlusion; missing target pixels alone do not suffice.
visibility_evidence.known_geometric_self: Earlier intersection with the same target mesh is geometric S/outside learned D/E; do not label external E.
visibility_evidence.unresolved: No depth, range tie/quantization, owner overlap/unassigned, off-image, uncertain ray/edge/registration or unrecognizable cue remain U.
visibility_evidence.not_yet_computed: No target-alone ray tests or depth/mask pixel sampling, no actual visual cue review, no 2D uncertainty estimates or D/E/S labels in this artifact.
visibility_evidence.sampling: Future source q/L/operator must be prospectively frozen separately; GT projection is label/evidence, not silently substituted for actual initializer q.

limitations: All1100 cached instances of these four objects are TRAIN; fixed existing VAL contains zero of these IDs, so this alone supplies no independent source-heldout assessment.
Model surface ownership is certified only in mesh geometry; distinct physical corner/part appearance and transfer to flat wooden pallet are UNKNOWN.
PCA box-to-vertex construction intentionally changes AUX reference definition, never the original virtual/native reference.
5mm neighbor ranges and normal angles are geometry diagnostics, not human localization uncertainty or selected visibility thresholds.
